name: Canva
shortDescription: Real estate video templates and a video editor for listing clips. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Canva's real estate video gallery says you can start from a listing template and customize it. The real estate solutions page says the video editor can create listing videos and walk-throughs and add music. Those pages do not list a monthly plan price.
pricingNotes: The real estate video gallery is presented as free to start. No monthly plan price was on the pages we read.
freeTierNotes: The template gallery says the real estate video templates are free to customize. A lasting free export limit was not spelled out.
bestFor: A listing video started from a real estate template
Adding photos, captions, and music in one editor
strength: Canva's real estate pages say you can start a listing video or walk-through from a template and add music.
weakness: The real estate pages do not list a monthly plan price, so this card states none.
smokeTestNotes: Real estate video gallery and solutions page reviewed on October 19, 2026.

useCaseFit.listing-videos: Trims listing clips, adds captions, and can add music.
